name: Nameshi Leather
description: A quiet, handmade store theme for a small leather atelier in a riverside workshop district, making vegetable-tanned wallets, bags and belts by hand and repairing them for life, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Parchment pages, tan panels, ink-brown text and a saddle accent; Libre Baskerville for display, Epilogue for text. A centred Libre Baskerville wordmark between two tiny dashed stitch marks with the menu split left and right on a parchment bar, a stitched seam beneath (H2); the home page opens with a compact title block (Made to patina) and goes straight into a filter-first directory of every piece by item (wallets, bags, belts) and leather (natural, black, indigo) on stitched hairline cells, each with a new / one year / five years patina strip under its price (L14); then how leather ages, the synced repair and care promise and the journal. A split two-tone footer: the parchment workshop card beside an ink-brown band with the newsletter and links (F10). Patina guide, Repairs and The atelier pages, journal, newsletter and contact. The workshop address, hours, telephone and email, and the repair and care policy, each live in one synced pattern (WooCommerce optional: without it the directory shows static cells and orders go by email).
deviation: Codes: none (H2 + F10 + L14 as planned; combination unused: Kuyuru Incense H2/F1/L12, Kura Shizuku H2/F3/L7, Komugi Pan H2/F8/L11, Sakura Juku H2/F11/L6; Tsuya Lacquer H4/F10/L1, Ginrin Cycle H6/F10/L11, Sushi Ginza H5/F10/L3; Kumo Eyewear H6/F4/L14, Sumai Realty H9/F6/L14, Neiro Hall H7/F9/L14). Palette as planned (parchment #EFE7DD, tan #C9A27E, ink brown #3A2A1F, saddle #7A5236) with added colours, all AA-checked: ink brown is 11.2:1 on parchment, 5.9:1 on tan and 12.3:1 on pale parchment; saddle is 5.6:1 on parchment (used there for labels and italic accents) but only 2.9:1 on tan, so on tan it appears only as rules and marks; deep saddle #4E321F was added for links and small text on tan (9.5:1 on parchment, 5.0:1 on tan); quiet brown #5E4A3B for secondary text, used on parchment and pale parchment only (6.8:1 / 7.5:1; 3.6:1 on tan, so tan panels use ink); pale parchment #F7F2EA cards and a seam hairline #B89878 (decorative). Buttons are ink with parchment text (11.2:1); the footer band is ink brown with parchment text (11.2:1), muted parchment #D9C7B2 labels (8.3:1) and tan links (5.9:1). H2 differs from Kuyuru, Kura, Komugi and Sakura by a stitched dashed seam under the bar and tiny dashed stitch marks either side of the centred wordmark (no pills, frames or stickers); the menu splits three left / three right with account and cart in the right cluster, and becomes a Menu button below 1180px. F10 differs from Tsuya (black/cinnabar), Ginrin (graphite/steel) and Sushi (navy/hinoki) as parchment and ink brown halves with a stitched link rule. L14 differs from Kumo (titanium eyewear cells), Sumai (ruled listings) and Neiro (ticket stubs) by stitched leather cells with a patina strip under each price. Fonts verified against google/fonts OFL.txt: Libre Baskerville carries the Reserved Font Name 'Libre Baskerville', so its two variable TTFs (Roman and Italic, weights 400-700) ship unmodified; Epilogue is OFL-1.1 without a Reserved Font Name (variable Latin WOFF2 subset, as in Tsuya Lacquer). Added a newsletter page because check-themes requires it; industry leather-goods, style crafted, colour brown and page tags patina-guide and repairs are new (The atelier uses the about tag).
